reviews.title: UNSAFE ADVERTISING ON THIS APP
reviews.text: Every time I open this app there are advertisements that show up and mimic the app and tell users their phones are hacked

reviews.title: Not very good
reviews.text: I don’t understand why this app has a high rating because there’s literally 1 workout unless you pay for the full version which appears to be a different app altogether.

reviews.title: Info Grab
reviews.text: If my card is  not going to be charged then you don’t need it and I should be able to see the app without being required to give my card data. It’s one nuisance to have to create an account before I get to even decide if I like the app, but I’m not giving you my card data too.
